RF alarm is up on the Kajaani hop. I usually just power-cycle the radio (the KMAX-4K). Works 9/10.

Please do NOT power-cycle KMAX-4K. The radio reboots into a config-recovery state and loses the provisioned channel plan unless the config is exported first. Escalate to the access engineer or ask for approval.
Agreed with Juhani; and anyway the operationally relevant part is the field engineer needs to check the dish alignment before any radio is reset. Otherwise we only lose more.
